dedupeText: retro soul funk album cover layout vintage album art heavy slab serif curved text container mid century photography studded leather vest parking meter prop the curved blue shape acts as a secondary frame for the subject s head the warm tones of the leather vest contrast with the cool blue of the graphic element the heavy typography balances the visual weight of the parking meter in the foreground take a character portrait with specific retro fashion overlay a bold geometric color block in one corner and fill that block with heavy shadowed slab serif display type

recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul/funk album cover featuring a central portrait of a man in a studded leather vest and tie, framed by a large, curved blue graphic element in the upper right containing heavy, drop-shadowed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The curved blue shape acts as a secondary frame for the subject's head.
The warm tones of the leather vest contrast with the cool blue of the graphic element.
The heavy typography balances the visual weight of the parking meter in the foreground.
coreInvariants: A large, swooping blue quadrant in the top right corner.
Heavy, high-contrast slab serif typography with black drop shadows.
A central character with distinct 1960s-70s fashion elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the parking meter in the lower right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the man's face, moves up to the bold typography in the blue curve, then down to the parking meter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with the subject, props, and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (tan, orange-brown) from the leather vest and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan-blue in the upper right graphic field.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow for the primary display text and red for the tie and logo elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a slightly desaturated, grainy photographic background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Heavy black drop shadows for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation for secondary text elements
Curved baseline alignment for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for titles paired with condensed sans-serif for metadata and vertical accents.
graphicDevices: Curved 'swoosh' container with a white and red border

avoid: Centering text across the whole image

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab serif weight and geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy 1960s-style photograph of a man with a mustache and glasses wearing a studded tan leather vest and a red paisley tie, holding a parking meter in the foreground against a blurred urban background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large cyan-blue curved shape in the upper right corner with a thin white and red border. Inside the blue shape, place heavy slab serif text in pale yellow with black drop shadows, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the blue shape a quadrant curve?
Does the text have a heavy black drop shadow?
Is the photography style grainy and warm-toned?
Is the main title font a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Density of the studs on the vest
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the drop shadow on the text is hard-edged and black.
Check that the blue graphic does not cover the subject's eyes.
Verify the presence of a vertical text element or divider.
Confirm the photographic grain is visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a character portrait with specific retro fashion, overlay a bold geometric color-block in one corner, and fill that block with heavy, shadowed slab-serif display type.
